name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt (five animated styles, /bar-style), plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, time left, context, cost and time. Follows the main session too when no subagent runs.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts; always: as soon as a session starts

stepReports.title: Step reports
stepReports.description: all: every subagent is asked to report its steps, so its row shows time left; savvy: only savvy-flow workers

mainBar.title: Show the main session's work
mainBar.description: on: with no subagents running, the bar shows the main session: tool calls, elapsed time and the last tool while it works, ready with the last turn's totals between turns; off: the bar is for subagents and flows only

barStyle.title: Progress bar style
barStyle.description: liquid (the default): a liquid with a rippling edge, drifting ripples and rising bubbles; pixels: a dithered fill of twinkling pixels; crab: a crab walks the track to where the work has got to, leaving footprints; aurora: soft lights drift through the fill; circuit: a lit circuit trace with a pulse running to its head. /bar-style switches it from the prompt and wins over this.
